title: Multi-domain spectral approach for Zakharov-Kuznetsov equations in 3D with cylindrical symmetry
summary: We present a novel numerical framework for studying nonlinear dispersive equations in higher-dimensional settings, specifically designed for solutions featuring traveling waves along a preferred axis (or field-aligned traveling waves). Using the three-dimensional generalized Zakharov-Kuznetsov (gZK) equation as a model, we convert it into cylindrical coordinates and implement a domain decomposition strategy.
